title: Dragon
author: Delatronic
description: Dragon model by Delatronic, originally shared on Blend Swap at https://www.blendswap.com/blends/view/80766. The converted Mitsuba scene is distributed as part of Benedikt Bitterli's Rendering Resources collection.

additionalCredits.name: Benedikt Bitterli
additionalCredits.contribution: Mitsuba scene conversion and resource packaging

changes: Repacked as a single GLB; textures limited to 1024px; geometry compressed/quantized with gltf-transform Meshopt without simplification; PNG textures compressed with lossless WebP; default camera embedded; preview rendered with MuTracer and denoised with OIDN standard. The DragonBSDF uses full transmission, IOR 1.5, zero roughness and pale blue volume absorption; the pedestal uses the colorless MuTracer Glass preset.
